node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-two-one factor reduction
node.statement: For a cubic 3+2+1 packet, the triple color gives a monic cubic factor F of L=FG. On the complementary cubic G, F takes values B,B,lambda B, where lambda=(gamma-alpha)/(beta-alpha); hence Res_W(G,X-F)=X^3-(2+lambda)BX^2+(1+2lambda)B^2X-lambda B^3. Seven color orbits and six role assignments give at most 42 packets.
node.notes: Exact low-degree necessary factor model for 3+2+1 only. No factor packet is declared empty and all norm, Frobenius, cyclotomic, and inner filters remain open.
